blocks.label: Current Beat
blocks.body: Your steeds haul the carriage around a tight bend and stop hard. The path ahead is blocked: a vendor cart lies overturned, its fruit, vegetables, and spilled preserves scattered across the trail. Something has been feeding here. The air is wrong: sweet rot...

blocks.label: Public Objective
blocks.body: Figure out what happened here and clear the road.

affordances: Ask one practical question before acting.
